fusions.name: Spring From the Reeds
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a sudden spring deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been hurt.

fusions.name: Damp Nibble
fusions.desc: A springing bite that deals 7 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its full reach of 5 tiles, and leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Under the Duckweed
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Skips the Puddles

riders.text: and you cross it faster than dry ground
and nothing wading after you can pin you down

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
